description:
Register (or idempotently update) an agent identity. Returns a
    deterministic content-addressed DID. capabilities is a non-empty list of
    lowercase capability tags other agents can discover you by.

agent_id.description: Your stable id for the agent.
agent_id.title: Agent Id

endpoint.description: Optional. The agent's MCP or HTTP endpoint URL.
endpoint.title: Endpoint

pricing.description: Optional. Pricing the agent advertises, as an object.
pricing.title: Pricing

pubkey.description: Optional. The agent's public key, for signed actions.
pubkey.title: Pubkey

reputation_hint.description: Optional. Starting reputation between 0 and 1. Default 0.5.
reputation_hint.title: Reputation Hint

name: register_agent
title: Register agent
